values.note: Standard non-electric $26; standard electric (water, sewer, 50-amp) $46 in peak season (late May to Labor Day) and $32 off-peak; tent-only $26, electric group shelter $45. The same in the 2027 and 2028 rate tables.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251946/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26, STANDARD ELECTRIC $46; Non-Peak 2026-04-03 to 2026-05-21: electric $32), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 251946 (all 5 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer; camp host site left out), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 9 bookable RV sites (5 standard electric with water and sewer, 4 standard non-electric) besides 16 tent-only sites and a group shelter. The 5 electric sites are pull-throughs listing 70-99 ft; the non-electric sites list no length.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 251946 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Water, flush toilets and showers are available from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend; a dump station is 'located nearby' (not stated to be on the campground).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251946 (Facilities: 'Available starting Memorial Day Weekend - Water, flush toilets, and showers. dump station located nearby - To Labor Day Weekend'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777. Arrivals without a reservation pay at the Tionesta Recreation Area booth (814-755-3592) for open sites before parking. 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days at the project.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251946 (notices: 'If you are arriving without a campground reservation, you must pay for camping before you park', 'Visit the Tionesta Recreation Area booth, Recreation.gov or call 1-877-444-6777 to determine if campsites are open and to pay for open sites'; facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $26-46 fees (standard non-electric / standard electric), 50-amp with water+sewer, reservable on rec.gov. Added 9 RV sites (5 electric pull-throughs 70-99 ft, 4 non-electric), showers/flush toilets/water (Memorial Day-Labor Day), 14-night max, walk-up payment at the booth in the booking note. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only), booking window, whether walk-ups are a formal FCFS policy (fcfs left unset); dump is 'nearby', not set; rec.gov's 'militaryDiscount' rule has no wording, discounts left alone.
